added: config.controls: ARC (G), flashlight (E) and laser (L) are game controls while a taser is in hand
changed: ARC, flashlight, laser, probe removal and AFID collection are no longer key bindings
Probe removal and AFID prompts use E only while shown and win over the flashlight
TASER 10 warning alert strobes the weapon flashlight
AFID confetti off for TASER 7 and TASER 10
Fewer notifications: arm / safe, low battery, reload, removal, empty trigger and the 15 s warning are gone
fixed: Firing with a dead battery showed the shot without using a cartridge, the trigger now does nothing
Trigger did nothing while the aim was locked onto a target (assisted aim)
Custom taser weapons with a high hash did not match their device state and never fired

changed: Profile option cid is now display: 1 = bay screen, 2 = magazine screen
fixed: First trigger pull could fire the game's own stun gun while the fire animation loaded

changed: Source cleanup: trailing whitespace and blank lines removed

added: npc.enabled: turn NPC reactions to warnings and shocks off
battery.enabled: turn battery packs off, the taser always has power
reload.mode: items, free (reload key without items) or auto (spent bays refill on their own)
changed: reload settings moved next to the item settings in config/shared.lua
Live shocks are sent again every second and at once when a ped changes owner
The shooter takes control of a server owned NPC to apply the shock
fixed: Peds with attached probes sometimes did not fall when the ped changed owner
Ragdoll blocked by other scripts or NPC scenarios

changed: A body full of probes drops its oldest probe instead of rejecting new hits
fixed: Probes sometimes flew through running or animated peds and landed behind them
Probes that could not attach hung in the air instead of falling to the ground
First hit could miss while the probe model was still loading
Probes detached from a ped are attached again

added: TASER 7 and TASER 10 profiles, X2 and X26P ready to map
Probe flight with real cartridge spread, wires and 5 second cycles
Spread based effect: NMI, partial lockup, pain compliance
Trigger hold, ARC re-energize, warning arc and alert, drive stun
Battery packs, cartridges, magazines and dock stored in weapon metadata
Laser dots, flashlight and TASER 10 alert strobe
Native sounds for every device event
Device display HUD with /thud menu to show, hide, move and resize
Cartridge serials, device log, incident reports, Discord webhook and epsilon_cad reports
AFID confetti evidence and Axon Signal events
